home.description: A space to show how using AI in a creative and deeply human way can transform the way clients reach their most aspirational goals.
home.featuredFocusTitle: From business context to executive-ready demos.
home.featuredFocusDesc: Laila helps structure ideas, turn them into solutions, and express them as visual, narrative, and demonstrable assets.
home.approachDesc: A combination of commercial narrative, technical judgment, and rapid prototyping.
home.whyTitle: A more visual and structured way to present what I build.
home.whyDesc: A collaborative space to centralize ideas, solutions, and learnings that accelerate the creation of AI value. Laila turns shared knowledge into reusable tools, clear paths, and experiences that help clients reach their most ambitious goals.
home.thanksText: Laila wasn't born alone — and that makes it more real. {larissa} gave it creative soul. {gabo} and {caro} believed from the start. {aura}, {juanes}, {cami}, {juli}, and {luisfa} trusted it and every challenge they brought made it grow. And to everyone who contributed an idea, an opinion, or simply let themselves be surprised by what Laila can do — this belongs to you too.

about.title: Mindset drives results
about.description: This page presents a more personal-professional view of me: my approach, my experience, how I work, and the type of value I seek to build through solutions and narratives.
about.approachTitle: I connect business goals & desires, technology and storytelling.
about.approachDesc1: I'm interested in building solutions that not only work, but are also understood, inspire trust, and help move client conversations forward in a clear and strategic way.
about.approachDesc2: My work usually lives at the intersection of solution design, executive narrative, digital experience, AI and all within Salesforce.
about.profileTagline: Crafting stories of business transformation through AI-powered experiences — designed to captivate, inspire, and make possibilities feel real.

highlights.label: Focus
highlights.value: AI, Agentforce, Data Cloud, Service Cloud

about.enjoyDesc: I like translating complex problems into stories, solutions, and experiences that are easy to understand and present.
about.howDesc: I combine strategic thinking with practical execution: structure, content, demo, narrative, and visual detail.
about.whyTitle: A platform for what I build
about.whyDesc: Laila summarizes my interest in connecting creativity, business, technology, and experience to build something reusable and forward-thinking.
about.ctaDesc: If you have a challenge, an opportunity, or simply want to explore how AI can transform your business — let's talk.

approach.title: From business problem to demonstrable story.
approach.description: My approach combines client understanding, narrative design, solution architecture, and rapid asset building to visualize value.
approach.body: I work connecting three levels: the business problem, the technology solution, and the story that lets a client understand the value. My goal is not just to show features, but to build a clear, credible, and actionable conversation.

personas.title: The people that bring the Laila universe to life.
personas.description: Each one represents a distinct dimension: the creator, the executor, and the explorer. Together, they define how Laila is imagined, built, and experienced.

items.name: Laila
items.tagline: The magic that connects it all.
items.description: Laila is the living representation of everything that inhabits this universe: creativity, technology, inclusion, and possibility. She creates to share, imagines to inspire, and deeply believes that all industries, all ideas, and all people have a place in transformation.

items.name: Janine Service
items.tagline: The one who turns service into experience.
items.description: Janine is strategy, precision, and empathy in motion. Her specialty is customer service, but her talent goes far beyond: she understands the business, solves with elegance, and elevates every interaction. Together with Laila, they form an unstoppable duo: vision and execution, magic and method.

items.name: María Clara Giménez
items.tagline: The first to believe, test, and transform.
items.description: María Clara doesn't wait for the future to arrive: she tests it before anyone else. She's curious, active, and always ready to discover new products, generate cases, and test Laila's innovations. More than a client, she's the spark that confirms every idea can become a great experience.
